Bihar MLC Election Results 2026: niraj kumar (Neeraj Kumar) ne patna snatak nirvachan kshetr se chauthi bar jit darj karne ke bad nitish kumar (Nitish Kumar) se mulakat ki. nitish ne unhen 'nyay ke sath vikas' ke mulmantr par janseva jari rakhne ki salah di, vahin jadyu ne jit ko sushasan ka praman bataya.
